---
title: "ARBITER results against blinded expert ratings"
---

[Home](index.html) · [Results](results.html) · [Supplement](supplement.html) · [Software](https://github.com/AliSalman-et-al/ARBITER/) · [Study repository and reproduction](https://github.com/AliSalman-et-al/arbiter-JAMIA)

ARBITER is an available workflow that separates model interpretation from executable rules for the Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomised trials (RoB 2) and retains sources, answers and evidence for inspection. We compared its complete Sonnet workflow with the same model given a minimal prompt and identical supplied files for 102 trials from 16 reviews. Two experts independently rated all 510 domain cells before viewing labels. A separate conditional forced-choice endpoint used the 60 agreed choices among 80 arm-discordant cells.


## Tables

```{r}
titles <- c('Benchmark and reference context','Conditional primary endpoint and core sensitivities','Process checks and computational resources')
for(i in 1:3) {
  cat('\n### Table ',i,'. ',titles[i],'\n\n',sep='')
  raw <- paste(readLines(paste0('output/manuscript/qa/Table',i,'.html'),encoding='UTF-8'),collapse='\n')
  raw <- sub('data-quarto-disable-processing="false"','data-quarto-disable-processing="true"',raw,fixed=TRUE)
  cat('\n```{=html}\n',raw,'\n```\n',sep='')
  cat('\n\n[Download editable Word table](output/manuscript/Table',i,'.docx)\n\n',sep='')
}
```

## Reproduction

The [study repository](https://github.com/AliSalman-et-al/arbiter-JAMIA) contains the analysis pipeline, test suite, numerical exports and output verifier. [Supplementary methods and results](supplement.html) provide secondary estimates, full question-level panels, prompts, the worked trace and reporting locations. Trial PDFs are not redistributed.
